commands.decorativewings.usage: Usage: /wings give <player> [sprite|model|insect|bird|sprite_v1|model_v1|insect_v1|bird_v1]  or  /wings remove <player>. First-person: /wingsfp on|off
commands.decorativewings.unknown: Unknown wing type '%s'. Use sprite, model, insect, bird, or *_v1.
